comparison.objective: Lock a vinyl tile by angling its tongue into a laid row and lowering it flat, versus seating a collet in a nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-edge tongue-and-groove engagement followed by planar lowering; candidate captures a localized eccentric lip then tilts and rolls a small rotationally symmetric part.
comparison.success_condition: Tile must lie flat with its click-lock joint engaged; candidate requires 3-second released retention and withdrawal resistance. Candidate lacks numeric snap/pull thresholds.
comparison.reason: This is the closest shared angle-to-lock primitive, but the interface, motion constraints and verified ability are materially different.
